unlisted_practices: LLM-based video activity recognition benchmarked against conventional machine learning and deep learning baselines for nursing procedure training
Explainable AI (XAI) anomaly-detection-based automated feedback generation for nursing trainees

screen.reason: The paper develops and evaluates an LLM/multimodal video-based activity recognition and feedback system for endotracheal suctioning training in nursing education, testing model performance and pilot feedback generation.
